items.topic: Click pipeline restored after missing clicks
items.statement: Kobi reported the click (SLC) pipeline is running again. Clicks were missing because the flow still matched deals by deal makeup and failed when deal country and state were not sent; a misleading 'no player found' error also showed in the error list.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Um, but the main thing is the click pipeline is back up and running again.

items.topic: Unhandled flow error rolled back SLC records
items.statement: An unhandled error in the flow error path rolled back SLC record creation. The missing records could not be recovered from Salesforce. Jumpr was not set up to receive flow error messages, so the failure was silent; Kobi fixed this so Jumpr now gets flow errors.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: But um the error path for that flow was uh essentially failing. Um and when it failed, it stopped uh those SLC records from being created.

items.topic: SLC flow matches deals by Deal External ID only
items.statement: Kobi removed all matching by deal makeup from the SLC flow. The flow now relies only on the Deal External ID that Salesforce pushes to CMS and CMS sends back. Source information was added and signup currency now comes from the deal.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: So hopefully this doesn't happen again. Um but since I made I made a lot of changes to that flow actually um I incorporated the uh source information um removed all of the matching by the deal makeup. So right now we're only relying on the delectional ID which seems to be working fine
items.asr_note: 'delectional ID' / 'deleteral ID' / 'DL external ID' = Deal External ID [ASR]

items.topic: Hard lock prevents duplicate players
items.statement: Back-to-back clicks for the same user could create duplicate players (race condition). Kobi added a hard lock with a unique ID at database level and a retry after about 30 seconds to a minute that maps to the existing player.
items.quote: So we put in like a hard lock um where uh there is a unique ID being created at the database level. / Kobi Kunasekaran: So it should prevent um any duplicate player from being created even if uh even if they get processed at the same time.

items.topic: SLC click IDs sequential since last Tuesday
items.statement: SLC click IDs have been sequential since Tuesday of last week, when the automation was disabled and turned back on. The only errors seen are for deals not configured, which is expected.
items.quote: the SLC click IDs have been sequential since like Tuesday of last week when we disabled the automation and, uh, turned it back on. So, it leads me to believe everything is coming in um, that's being pushed from CMS. Uh the only errors that we see are some with without the deals configured and that's expected.

Ops then confirms it's fraud and then obviously they can't do anything with it. / Kobi Kunasekaran: So if it's dismissed, um the record goes back to like we basically remove the fraud flag when it's dismissed and then it stays / Kobi Kunasekaran: in whatever status it was.

items.quote: Lina Ceniccola: in progress and basically if like the client received funds then it has to go it has to be a write off and we have to consider it as part of erosion. / Emily Vandenberg: to write it off like click for kind of like a write off because really at any / Emily Vandenberg: status um you know this could happen

items.topic: Write-off checkbox and auto-archive on confirm
items.statement: When fraud review is Confirmed: if Payment Sent is checked, the Write-off checkbox is checked and used in reporting regardless of status; if Payment Sent is unchecked, a New record moves to Archived. This removes noise from the New list.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Um but if the prod review status is uh marked as confirmed, then we can check if the payment status is uh checked. And if this is checked, we'll check the write- off check box. And then that's what you'll use on the reporting side to make sure that it's included in the write-offs regardless of the status. Um, and then if payment sent is unchecked, then we will move new to archived once the fraud is confirmed. Okay, / Lina Ceniccola: Yeah.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Decisions > Aligned: "Duplicate deal creation prevention The system will implement logic to prevent the creation of duplicate deals when the operator, partner, market, country, and vertical fields are identical."
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I'll I'll make sure to add that in too so that next time these things get flagged. Um, I think I can do the same like maybe work off of the actual deal ID logic to flag it as a duplicate or something.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary is firmer: Kobi asked whether to prevent duplicates, but committed only to flag them, possibly using Deal External ID logic. No prevention/blocking rule was agreed.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Decisions > Aligned: "Fraud status handling process Signups confirmed as fraud will be archived if payment is not sent; if payment is sent, a write-off checkbox will be used to track the financial implication." (also Details: "if fraud is confirmed, the record will be archived")
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ... and then if payment sent is unchecked, then we will move new to archived once the fraud is confirmed.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary generalizes to all signups. Transcript limits the auto-archive to records in New status; for other statuses confirmed fraud locks the record for reps (line 309). The Details version also drops the payment-sent condition.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Details: "Kobi offered to create a video tutorial for Emily on how to manually create deals within the interface, as this responsibility will eventually shift to the operations team."
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ... to simulate like what it will look like when we go into uh when we get to the point where we're creating the deals directly in Salesforce. Uh you don't have to you can still send me the deals and I I'm happy to create them.
gemini_disagreements.why: Invented detail: no one said deal creation will shift to the operations team. Kobi said it is optional and he is happy to keep creating deals.
